description: Implement an improved telemetry system that provides better observability into pipeline operations. The system should capture detailed metrics and events from the API pipeline while maintaining privacy and configurability for self-hosted deployments. This will help with debugging, performance monitoring, and understanding usage patterns.
functional_requirements: Add telemetry instrumentation to the API pipeline to capture key events and performance metrics
Implement environment-based configuration to enable/disable telemetry features for different deployment scenarios
Ensure telemetry data respects privacy by making all captured data configurable and optional
Add comprehensive test coverage for telemetry functionality to verify correct behavior
Update documentation to clearly explain available telemetry options and their configuration
Maintain backward compatibility so existing deployments continue to work without changes
